####DEG lists

```{r}

seurat=seurat_AB015
Idents(seurat) <- "monocle_clusters"
DEG_all_clusters <- FindAllMarkers(seurat,only.pos = FALSE,
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0,
  min.cells.feature = 1,
  min.cells.group  = 1,
  features = rownames(seurat))
DEG_all_clusters$genes=rownames(DEG_all_clusters)#more genes because each gene can be associated to more than one cluster

# mature myotubes (cl4) vs early myotubes (cl9 and cl10)
DEG_cl4vs9_10 <- FindMarkers(
  seurat,only.pos = FALSE,
  ident.1 = "4", ident.2 = c("9","10"),
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0,
  min.cells.feature = 1,
  min.cells.group  = 1,
  features = rownames(seurat))
DEG_cl4vs9_10$genes=rownames(DEG_cl4vs9_10)
DEG_cl4vs9_10=DEG_cl4vs9_10%>%dplyr::select(genes,p_val_adj,avg_log2FC)
colnames(DEG_cl4vs9_10) <- c("geneID", "q_value_4vs9_10", "logFC_4vs9_10")

DEG_cl4vs9 <- FindMarkers(
  seurat,only.pos = FALSE,
  ident.1 = "4", ident.2 = "9",
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0,
  min.cells.feature = 1,
  min.cells.group  = 1,
  features = rownames(seurat))
DEG_cl4vs9$genes=rownames(DEG_cl4vs9)
DEG_cl4vs9=DEG_cl4vs9%>%dplyr::select(genes,p_val_adj,avg_log2FC)
colnames(DEG_cl4vs9) <- c("geneID", "q_value_4vs9", "logFC_4vs9")


# mature myotubes GERALT (cl4) vs mature myotubes OPTIOXD7 (cl7)
DEG_cl4vs7=FindMarkers(seurat,only.pos = FALSE, ident.1 = "4", ident.2 = c("7"),
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0,
  min.cells.feature = 1,
  min.cells.group  = 1,
  features = rownames(seurat))
DEG_cl4vs7$genes=rownames(DEG_cl4vs7)
DEG_cl4vs7=DEG_cl4vs7%>%dplyr::select(genes,p_val_adj,avg_log2FC)
colnames(DEG_cl4vs7) <- c("geneID", "q_value_4vs7", "logFC_4vs7")

# early myotubes post-fusion LONZA (cl9) vs mature GERALT (cl4)
DEG_cl9vs4=FindMarkers(seurat, only.pos = FALSE, ident.1 = "9", ident.2 = c("4"),
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0,
  min.cells.feature = 1,
  min.cells.group  = 1,
  features = rownames(seurat))
DEG_cl9vs4$genes=rownames(DEG_cl9vs4)
DEG_cl9vs4=DEG_cl9vs4%>%dplyr::select(genes,p_val_adj,avg_log2FC)
colnames(DEG_cl9vs4) <- c("geneID", "q_value_9vs4", "logFC_9vs4")

# embryonic isoform cluster (cl10) vs mature GERALT (cl4) - same sample, different maturity
DEG_cl10vs4=FindMarkers(seurat,only.pos = FALSE, ident.1 = "10", ident.2 = c("4"),
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0,
  min.cells.feature = 1,
  min.cells.group  = 1,
  features = rownames(seurat))
DEG_cl10vs4$genes=rownames(DEG_cl10vs4)
DEG_cl10vs4=DEG_cl10vs4%>%dplyr::select(genes,p_val_adj,avg_log2FC)
colnames(DEG_cl10vs4) <- c("geneID", "q_value_10vs4", "logFC_10vs4")

# cycling myoblasts LONZA (cl8) vs early post-fusion LONZA (cl9)
DEG_cl8vs9=FindMarkers(seurat, only.pos = FALSE, ident.1 = "8", ident.2 = c("9"),
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0,
  min.cells.feature = 1,
  min.cells.group  = 1,
  features = rownames(seurat))
DEG_cl8vs9$genes=rownames(DEG_cl8vs9)
DEG_cl8vs9=DEG_cl8vs9%>%dplyr::select(genes,p_val_adj,avg_log2FC)
colnames(DEG_cl8vs9) <- c("geneID", "q_value_8vs9", "logFC_8vs9")

# cycling WT progenitors (cl3) vs FAP/progenitors LONZA (cl6)
DEG_cl3vs6=FindMarkers(seurat, only.pos = FALSE, ident.1 = "3", ident.2 = c("6"),
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0,
  min.cells.feature = 1,
  min.cells.group  = 1,
  features = rownames(seurat))
DEG_cl3vs6$genes=rownames(DEG_cl3vs6)
DEG_cl3vs6=DEG_cl3vs6%>%dplyr::select(genes,p_val_adj,avg_log2FC)
colnames(DEG_cl3vs6) <- c("geneID", "q_value_3vs6", "logFC_3vs6")

# myofibroblasts LONZA post (cl1) vs fibroblasts WT D4 (cl5)
DEG_cl1vs5=FindMarkers(seurat, only.pos = FALSE, ident.1 = "1", ident.2 = c("5"),
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0,
  min.cells.feature = 1,
  min.cells.group  = 1,
  features = rownames(seurat))
DEG_cl1vs5$genes=rownames(DEG_cl1vs5)
DEG_cl1vs5=DEG_cl1vs5%>%dplyr::select(genes,p_val_adj,avg_log2FC)
colnames(DEG_cl1vs5) <- c("geneID", "q_value_1vs5", "logFC_1vs5")

# myofibroblasts LONZA post (cl1) vs FAP progenitors LONZA pre (cl6)
# this asks: what changes when LONZA cells "fail" to differentiate?
DEG_cl1vs6=FindMarkers(seurat, only.pos = FALSE, ident.1 = "1", ident.2 = c("6"),
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0,
  min.cells.feature = 1,
  min.cells.group  = 1,
  features = rownames(seurat))
DEG_cl1vs6$genes=rownames(DEG_cl1vs6)
DEG_cl1vs6=DEG_cl1vs6%>%dplyr::select(genes,p_val_adj,avg_log2FC)
colnames(DEG_cl1vs6) <- c("geneID", "q_value_1vs6", "logFC_1vs6")

# stromal clusters (cl1+cl5) vs myotube clusters (cl4+cl7+cl9+cl10)
DEG_cl1_5vs4_7_9_10=FindMarkers(seurat, only.pos = FALSE, ident.1 = c("1","5"), ident.2 = c("4","7","9","10"),
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0,
  min.cells.feature = 1,
  min.cells.group  = 1,
  features = rownames(seurat))
DEG_cl1_5vs4_7_9_10$genes=rownames(DEG_cl1_5vs4_7_9_10)
DEG_cl1_5vs4_7_9_10=DEG_cl1_5vs4_7_9_10%>%dplyr::select(genes,p_val_adj,avg_log2FC)
colnames(DEG_cl1_5vs4_7_9_10) <- c("geneID", "q_value_1_5vs4_7_9_10", "logFC_1_5vs4_7_9_10")

# neural/iPSC transition OPTIOXD4 (cl2) vs FAP progenitors LONZA pre (cl6)
DEG_cl2vs6=FindMarkers(seurat, only.pos = FALSE, ident.1 = "2", ident.2 = c("6"),
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0,
  min.cells.feature = 1,
  min.cells.group  = 1,
  features = rownames(seurat))
DEG_cl2vs6$genes=rownames(DEG_cl2vs6)
DEG_cl2vs6=DEG_cl2vs6%>%dplyr::select(genes,p_val_adj,avg_log2FC)
colnames(DEG_cl2vs6) <- c("geneID", "q_value_2vs6", "logFC_2vs6")

#neural/iPSC OPTIOXD4 (cl2) vs intermediate myotubes OPTIOXD7 (cl7)
# same cell line, D4 vs D7 — asks what changes during differentiation in OPTIOXD7
DEG_cl2vs7=FindMarkers(seurat, only.pos = FALSE, ident.1 = "2", ident.2 = c("7"),
  test.use = "wilcox",
  logfc.threshold = 0,
  min.pct = 0,
  min.cells.feature = 1,
  min.cells.group  = 1,
  features = rownames(seurat))
DEG_cl2vs7$genes=rownames(DEG_cl2vs7)
DEG_cl2vs7=DEG_cl2vs7%>%dplyr::select(genes,p_val_adj,avg_log2FC)
colnames(DEG_cl2vs7) <- c("geneID", "q_value_2vs7", "logFC_2vs7")

# LONZA post-fusion myofibroblasts (cl1, n=1602) vs LONZA post-fusion myotubes (cl9, n=578)
# asks: what determines whether a LONZA cell differentiates or becomes fibroblastic?
DEG_cl1vs9=FindMarkers(seurat, only.pos = FALSE, ident.1 = "1", ident.2 = c("9"),
```

```{r}
#Set the significance level cutoff
sig_level <- 0.01
#Set a fold-change cutoff
fc_level <- log2(2)
fc_level2 <- (log2(2))*-1
###################################
N=20
list=c("4vs9_10",
  "4vs9",
  "4vs7",
  "9vs4",
  "10vs4",
  "8vs9",
  "3vs6",
  "1vs5",
  "1vs6",
  "1_5vs4_7_9_10",
  "2vs6",
  "2vs7",
  "1vs9",
  "4_7_9_10vs1_3_5_6_11",
  "1vsall",
  "2vsall",
  "3vsall",
  "4vsall",
  "5vsall",
  "6vsall",
  "7vsall",
  "8vsall",
  "9vsall",
  "10vsall",
  "11vsall")

for (i in list) {
  cluster_name <- paste0("clust", i)
  
  # Create column names dynamically
  logFC_col <- paste0("logFC_", i)
  q_value_col <- paste0("q_value_", i)
  treshold_col <- paste0("treshold_cl", i)
  Log10pvalue_col <- paste0("Log10pvalue_cl", i)
  
  # Apply thresholding logic
  de_stats[[treshold_col]] <- ifelse(de_stats[[logFC_col]] >= fc_level & de_stats[[q_value_col]] <= sig_level, "up",
                                      ifelse(de_stats[[logFC_col]] <= fc_level2 & de_stats[[q_value_col]] <= sig_level, "down", "other"))
  
  de_stats[[Log10pvalue_col]] <- -log10(de_stats[[q_value_col]]+1e-305)
}

N <- 25
contrasts <- c("4vs9_10",
  "4vs9",
  "4vs7",
  "9vs4",
  "10vs4",
  "8vs9",
  "3vs6",
  "1vs5",
  "1vs6",
  "1_5vs4_7_9_10",
  "2vs6",
  "2vs7",
  "1vs9",
  "4_7_9_10vs1_3_5_6_11",
  "1vsall",
  "2vsall",
  "3vsall",
  "4vsall",
  "5vsall",
  "6vsall",
  "7vsall",
  "8vsall",
  "9vsall",
  "10vsall",
  "11vsall")

for (i in contrasts) {
  logFC_col       <- paste0("logFC_", i)
  q_value_col     <- paste0("q_value_", i)
  Log10pvalue_col <- paste0("Log10pvalue_cl", i)
  to_show_col     <- paste0("to_show_cl", i)

  de_stats[[Log10pvalue_col]] <- -log10(de_stats[[q_value_col]] + 1e-305)

  up_idx <- !is.na(de_stats[[logFC_col]]) &
            !is.na(de_stats[[q_value_col]]) &
            de_stats[[logFC_col]] >= fc_level &
            de_stats[[q_value_col]] <= sig_level

  down_idx <- !is.na(de_stats[[logFC_col]]) &
              !is.na(de_stats[[q_value_col]]) &
              de_stats[[logFC_col]] <= fc_level2 &
              de_stats[[q_value_col]] <= sig_level

  up_candidates <- which(up_idx)
  down_candidates <- which(down_idx)

  up_top <- up_candidates[
    order(de_stats[[Log10pvalue_col]][up_candidates], decreasing = TRUE)
  ][seq_len(min(N, length(up_candidates)))]

  down_top <- down_candidates[
    order(de_stats[[Log10pvalue_col]][down_candidates], decreasing = TRUE)
  ][seq_len(min(N, length(down_candidates)))]

  show_idx <- logical(nrow(de_stats))
  show_idx[up_top] <- TRUE
  show_idx[down_top] <- TRUE

  de_stats[[to_show_col]] <- ifelse(show_idx, de_stats$geneID, "")
}
stat_filename = paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_gene_reg_with_directions.csv")
write.csv(de_stats, stat_filename, quote = F, row.names = T, sep=",")

  volcano_plot <- ggplot(data = de_stats, aes(x = !!rlang::sym(logFC_col), y = !!rlang::sym(Log10pvalue_col))) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = as.factor(!!rlang::sym(treshold_col))), size = 1.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("up" = "red", "down" = "blue", "other" = "grey")) +
     ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
  data = de_stats %>%
    filter(!!rlang::sym(q_value_col) < 0.05),
  aes(label = !!rlang::sym(to_show_col)),
  size = 3,
  box.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
  point.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
  segment.color = "grey",
  segment.size = 0.2,max.overlaps =100
)+
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = (log10(sig_level) * -1),linetype="dotted") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(fc_level, fc_level2),linetype="dotted") +
    xlim(c(-100, 80)) + ylim(c(0, 350)) +
    xlab("log2 fold change") + ylab("-Log10 adj p-value")+
  annotate("text", x = -60, y = 350, label = paste("comparison cl ", i), col = "black", size = 4, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)# +
    # Add "other clusters" on the top left for clusters other than the current one
   # annotate("text", x = -4, y = 200, label = "Other Clusters", col = "black", size = 4, hjust = 0, vjust = 1)


  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fname_prefix_dotplot, "_cl", i, ".pdf"),
    plot = volcano_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 6
  )
}
```

```{r}
  syms <- unique(names(gene_sets[[nm]]))
  if (!length(syms)) next

  id_map <- suppressMessages(
    bitr(syms, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
  )
  entrez <- unique(id_map$ENTREZID)
  if (!length(entrez)) next

  ego <- enrichGO(
    gene          = entrez,
    OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType       = "ENTREZID",
    ont           = "BP",
    universe      = universe_entrez,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    pvalueCutoff  = 1,
    readable      = TRUE
  )

  ego_list[[nm]] <- ego
  GO_list[[nm]]  <- as.data.frame(ego)
}

# Write every GO table to CSV
if (length(GO_list)) {
  for (nm in names(GO_list)) {
    if (is.null(GO_list[[nm]]) || !nrow(GO_list[[nm]])) next
    file <- paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_GO_", nm, ".csv")
    write.csv(GO_list[[nm]], file, row.names = FALSE)
    message("Wrote: ", file)
  }
}

# Helper: safe save for ggplot objects
save_plot <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 8, height = 6) {
  if (inherits(plot_obj, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(filename = filename, plot = plot_obj, width = width, height = height)
    message("Saved plot: ", filename)
  } else {
    message("Skipping (not a ggplot): ", filename)
  }
}

# Make dotplots and barplots for each ego in ego_list
if (length(ego_list)) {
  for (nm in names(ego_list)) {
    ego <- ego_list[[nm]]
    if (is.null(ego)) next

    res_df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(ego), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(res_df) || !nrow(res_df)) next

    p_dot <- tryCatch(
      dotplot(ego, showCategory = 15, x = "Count"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    save_plot(
      p_dot,
      paste0(fname_prefix_GO, "_dotplot_GO_", nm, ".pdf"),
      width = 8, height = 8
    )

    p_bar <- tryCatch(
      barplot(ego, x = "FoldEnrichment", showCategory = 15),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    save_plot(
      p_bar,
      paste0(fname_prefix_GO, "_bar_GO_", nm, ".pdf"),
      width = 8, height = 4
    )
  }
}
```

###run clusterprofiler
#GSEA analysis on clusters

```{r}
####make gene list to study

###run clusterprofiler
#GSEA analysis on clusters

library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(DOSE)

set_min_n_genes <- 5

# Build ranked gene lists from ALL genes in each contrast
contrast_cols <- c("4vs9_10",
  "4vs9",
  "4vs7",
  "9vs4",
  "10vs4",
  "8vs9",
  "3vs6",
  "1vs5",
  "1vs6",
  "1_5vs4_7_9_10",
  "2vs6",
  "2vs7",
  "1vs9",
  "4_7_9_10vs1_3_5_6_11",
  "1vsall",
  "2vsall",
  "3vsall",
  "4vsall",
  "5vsall",
  "6vsall",
  "7vsall",
  "8vsall",
  "9vsall",
  "10vsall",
  "11vsall")

gene_sets_GSEA <- list()

for (ctr in contrast_cols) {
  fc_col <- paste0("logFC_", ctr)

  if (!fc_col %in% colnames(de_stats)) next

  df <- de_stats[, c("geneID", fc_col)]
  colnames(df) <- c("geneID", "logFC")

  df <- df[!is.na(df$geneID) & df$geneID != "", ]
  df <- df[!is.na(df$logFC), ]

  # remove duplicate genes, keep the row with largest absolute logFC
  df <- df[order(-abs(df$logFC)), ]
  df <- df[!duplicated(df$geneID), ]

  genes <- df$logFC
  names(genes) <- df$geneID
  genes <- sort(genes, decreasing = TRUE)

  gene_sets_GSEA[[ctr]] <- genes
}

# sanity check
stopifnot(all(sapply(gene_sets_GSEA, function(x) is.numeric(x) && !is.null(names(x)))))

# SYMBOL -> ENTREZ mapping
symbol_to_entrez <- suppressMessages(
  bitr(
    unique(unlist(lapply(gene_sets_GSEA, names))),
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType   = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
  )
)

gsea_list   <- list()
GSEA_tables <- list()

for (nm in names(gene_sets_GSEA)) {
  ranks_sym <- gene_sets_GSEA[[nm]]

  df <- data.frame(
    SYMBOL = names(ranks_sym),
    rank   = as.numeric(ranks_sym),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  df2 <- merge(df, symbol_to_entrez, by = "SYMBOL")
  if (!nrow(df2)) next

  # deduplicate ENTREZ: keep the entry with the highest absolute rank
  df2 <- df2[order(-abs(df2$rank)), ]
  df2 <- df2[!duplicated(df2$ENTREZID), ]

  ranks_entrez <- df2$rank
  names(ranks_entrez) <- df2$ENTREZID
  ranks_entrez <- sort(ranks_entrez, decreasing = TRUE)

  if (length(ranks_entrez) < set_min_n_genes) next

  gsea <- tryCatch(
    gseGO(
      geneList      = ranks_entrez,
      OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
      keyType       = "ENTREZID",
      ont           = "BP",
      minGSSize     = set_min_n_genes,
      maxGSSize     = 500,
      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
      pvalueCutoff  = 1,
      nPermSimple   = 10000,
      verbose       = FALSE,
      by            = "fgsea"
    ),
    error = function(e) {
      message("GSEA failed for ", nm, ": ", e$message)
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (is.null(gsea)) next

  gsea_readable <- tryCatch(
    setReadable(gsea, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db, keyType = "ENTREZID"),
    error = function(e) gsea
  )

  gsea_list[[nm]]   <- gsea_readable
  GSEA_tables[[nm]] <- as.data.frame(gsea_readable)
}

# significant-only version for plotting
gsea_sig_list <- lapply(gsea_list, function(gsea_obj) {
  if (is.null(gsea_obj)) return(NULL)

  df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(gsea_obj), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(NULL)

  df_sig <- dplyr::filter(df, p.adjust < 0.05)
  if (!nrow(df_sig)) return(NULL)

  gsea_obj@result <- df_sig
  gsea_obj
})

# write GSEA tables
if (length(GSEA_tables)) {
  for (nm in names(GSEA_tables)) {
    if (is.null(GSEA_tables[[nm]]) || !nrow(GSEA_tables[[nm]])) next
    file <- paste0(fname_prefix_csv, "_GSEA_", nm, ".csv")
    write.csv(GSEA_tables[[nm]], file, row.names = FALSE)
    message("Wrote: ", file)
  }
}

# helper: save ggplot safely
.save_plot <- function(p, file, w = 8, h = 10) {
  if (!is.null(p) && inherits(p, "ggplot")) {
    ggsave(filename = file, plot = p, width = w, height = h)
    message("Saved: ", file)
  }
}

# dotplots for all GSEA results
plot_gsea_dotplots <- function(gsea_list, fname_prefix, show_k = 10, width = 8, height = 10) {
  if (!length(gsea_list)) {
    message("gsea_list is empty.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  for (nm in names(gsea_list)) {
    g <- gsea_list[[nm]]
    df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(g), error = function(e) NULL)

    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) {
      message("Skipping ", nm, " (no terms).")
      next
    }

    k <- min(show_k, nrow(df))

    p <- tryCatch(
      dotplot(g, showCategory = k, split = ".sign", orderBy = "NES") +
        facet_grid(. ~ .sign),
      error = function(e) {
        message("Plot error in ", nm, ": ", e$message)
        NULL
      }
    )

    out_pdf <- paste0(fname_prefix, "_GSEA_", nm, "_dotplot.pdf")
    .save_plot(p, out_pdf, w = width, h = height)
  }
}

plot_gsea_dotplots(gsea_list, fname_prefix = fname_prefix_GO, show_k = 15)

# helper: save enrichment plots for selected GO IDs
save_gsea_plots <- function(gsea_res, contrast_name, go_ids, prefix, width = 8, height = 6) {
  if (is.null(gsea_res)) return(invisible(NULL))

  res_df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(gsea_res), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(res_df) || !nrow(res_df)) return(invisible(NULL))

  for (go_id in go_ids) {
    if (go_id %in% res_df$ID) {
      p <- tryCatch(
        gseaplot2(gsea_res, geneSetID = go_id, title = paste0(contrast_name, " - ", go_id)),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (!is.null(p)) {
        out_file <- paste0(prefix, "_", contrast_name, "_", gsub(":", "-", go_id), ".pdf")
        ggsave(out_file, plot = p, width = width, height = height)
        message("Saved: ", out_file)
      }
    } else {
      message("GO term ", go_id, " not found in ", contrast_name)
    }
  }
}

# automatic enrichment plots:
# one for top positively enriched term and one for top negatively enriched term
save_top_bottom_gsea_plots <- function(gsea_list, prefix, padj_cutoff = 0.05, width = 8, height = 6) {
  for (nm in names(gsea_list)) {
    gsea_res <- gsea_list[[nm]]
    if (is.null(gsea_res)) next

    df <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(gsea_res), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) next

    df <- df[!is.na(df$NES) & !is.na(df$p.adjust), ]
    if (!nrow(df)) next

    df_sig <- df[df$p.adjust < padj_cutoff, , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(df_sig) == 0) {
      message("No significant GSEA terms for ", nm)
      next
    }

    pos_df <- df_sig[df_sig$NES > 0, , drop = FALSE]
    neg_df <- df_sig[df_sig$NES < 0, , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(pos_df) > 0) {
      pos_df <- pos_df[order(-pos_df$NES, pos_df$p.adjust), , drop = FALSE]
      top_pos_id <- pos_df$ID[1]

      p_pos <- tryCatch(
        gseaplot2(gsea_res, geneSetID = top_pos_id,
                  title = paste0(nm, " top positive: ", top_pos_id)),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (!is.null(p_pos)) {
        out_pos <- paste0(prefix, "_GSEA_", nm, "_top_positive_", gsub(":", "-", top_pos_id), ".pdf")
        ggsave(out_pos, plot = p_pos, width = width, height = height)
        message("Saved: ", out_pos)
      }
    }

    if (nrow(neg_df) > 0) {
      neg_df <- neg_df[order(neg_df$NES, neg_df$p.adjust), , drop = FALSE]
      top_neg_id <- neg_df$ID[1]

      p_neg <- tryCatch(
        gseaplot2(gsea_res, geneSetID = top_neg_id,
                  title = paste0(nm, " top negative: ", top_neg_id)),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (!is.null(p_neg)) {
        out_neg <- paste0(prefix, "_GSEA_", nm, "_top_negative_", gsub(":", "-", top_neg_id), ".pdf")
        ggsave(out_neg, plot = p_neg, width = width, height = height)
        message("Saved: ", out_neg)
      }
    }
  }
}

save_top_bottom_gsea_plots(gsea_list, prefix = fname_prefix_GO, padj_cutoff = 0.05)
```

```{r}
cluster_markers_plot <- list(
  cl2  = c("GNGT1", "SYN2", "NPTX1", "NXPH1", "LINGO1", "NCALD", "RBFOX1",
           "MT-ND2", "MT-CO3", "RPL35A", "RPS29","CDKN1C","CADM2","SLC26A3"),
  # iPSC-neural origin: GNGT1 è il marker più specifico (logFC 151 vs all),
  # SYN2/NPTX1/NXPH1/LINGO1/NCALD = firma neuronale residua,
  # RBFOX1 = splicing factor neurale/muscolare,
  # MT-ND2/MT-CO3 = alta biomassa mitocondriale caratteristica di questo cluster,
  # RPL35A/RPS29 = ribosomi abbondanti vs cl7 (stessa linea D7)

  cl6  = c("ALDH1A1", "CAV1", "CD9", "TGFBI", "FTH1", "TMSB10", "S100A6",
           "ROCK2", "RHOBTB1", "MYF5", "PNP", "ODC1"),
  # Myogenic progenitors/FAP-like: ALDH1A1+CAV1+CD9 = marcatori FAP validati,
  # TGFBI = TGF-β induced, risposta al microambiente,
  # FTH1/TMSB10/S100A6 = firma stromale quiescente,
  # ROCK2 = via Rho/ROCK attiva nei progenitori,
  # MYF5 = commitment miogenico precoce,
  # PNP/ODC1 = metabolismo nucleotidi (cellule quiescenti/slow cycling)

  cl8  = c("MKI67", "TOP2A", "CDC20", "CENPF", "H2AZ1", "UBE2C",
           "BIRC5", "CCNA2", "RRM2", "PCLAF", "MYF5", "HMOX1"),
  # Cycling myoblasts: MKI67/TOP2A/CDC20/CENPF/CCNA2/UBE2C/BIRC5/RRM2/PCLAF
  # = pannello canonico G2M/S (tutti top marker cl8vsall),
  # H2AZ1 = il più specifico di cl8 (logFC 84 vs all), cromatina aperta/plasticità,
  # MYF5 = identità miogenica mantenuta nel ciclo,
  # HMOX1 = stress ossidativo (presente in cl8vsall)

  cl10 = c("MYH3", "MYH8", "NEFM", "NES", "CCND2", "ARMCX3",
           "TNNI1", "TNNC1", "MYL4", "TTN"),
  # Transitional myotubes (embrionali): MYH3 è il marker assoluto (logFC inf vs all,
  # unico gene con logFC positivo enorme in cl10vs4),
  # MYH8 = isoforma neonatale, co-espressa con MYH3 nei top 25,
  # NEFM/NES = neurofilamenti transitori nei miotubi fetali,
  # CCND2 = ciclina D2, presente in cl10 ma non in cl4 (differenziamento incompleto),
  # ARMCX3 = mitocondriale, espresso in miotubi immaturi,
  # TNNI1/TNNC1/MYL4/TTN = sarcomero embrionale assembling

  cl9  = c("ANKRD1", "MYBPH", "TNNT3", "TNNT2", "CALM1", "F13A1",
           "CRYAB", "DES", "CDKN1A", "BIN1", "COX6A2", "PTGDS", "FHL1","MYOG","MYOD1"),
  # Post-fusion myotubes: ANKRD1 = sensore stress meccanico sarcomerico (logFC 307),
  # MYBPH/TNNT3/TNNT2/CALM1 = sarcomero nascente,
  # F13A1 = transglutaminasi, cross-linking ECM nei miotubi early,
  # CRYAB = αB-crystallin, chaperona upregolata durante fusione,
  # DES = desmina, primo filamento intermedio del sarcomero,
  # CDKN1A = p21, marker canonico di uscita dal ciclo/differenziamento terminale,
  # BIN1 = amphiphysin 2, tubulogenesi del reticolo sarcoplasmatico,
  # COX6A2 = subunità muscolo-specifica della citocromo c ossidasi,
  # PTGDS = prostaglandina D sintasi (miotubi early),
  # FHL1 = four-and-a-half LIM domain, sensore meccanico sarcomero

  cl7  = c("MYOD1", "MYL1", "CSRP3", "TNNC2", "DLK1", "IL17B",
           "NNAT", "PEG10", "SERPINI1", "KRT19", "MT-ND5", "LDHB","ID3","COMT","MYH7"),
  # MYOD1-high myotubes: MYOD1 = programma miogenico ancora attivo (logFC 81 vs all),
  # MYL1 = logFC inf vs all, isoforma fast light chain,
  # CSRP3 = muscle LIM protein, differenziamento terminale,
  # TNNC2 = troponina C fast, sarcomero fast-twitch,
  # DLK1/PEG10 = imprinted genes del differenziamento muscolare,
  # NNAT = neuronatin, transientemente espresso in miotubi iPSC,
  # SERPINI1 = neuroserpin, specifico OPTIOXD7,
  # KRT19 = cheratina semplice, miotubi iPSC giovani,
  # MT-ND5 = componente mitocondriale,
  # LDHB = lattato deidrogenasi B, metabolismo ossidativo incipiente

  cl4  = c("MYL2", "CA3", "MT-CO2", "MT-CYB", "MT-ATP6", "DLG2",
           "EEF1A1", "RPL3", "PALLD", "TPM1", "PTPRD", "CA3"),
  # Advanced myotubes: MYL2 = myosin light chain 2 slow/cardiaco, isoforma matura,
  # CA3 = anidrasi carbonica 3, marker di maturità muscolare (logFC 166 vs all),
  # MT-CO2/MT-CYB/MT-ATP6 = alta biomassa mitocondriale matura (ossidativa),
  # DLG2 = discs large homolog 2, organizzazione NMJ/membrana,
  # EEF1A1/RPL3 = alta attività traduzionale (sintesi proteica sarcomero),
  # PALLD = palladin, organizzazione citoscheletro sarcomerico,
  # TPM1 = tropomiosina 1, isoforma adulta,
  # PTPRD = protein tyrosine phosphatase delta, maturità neuromuscolare

  cl11 = c("SSMEM1", "ZBED2", "C6", "S100A4", "S100A6", "ADIRF",
           "TMSB10", "FTH1", "LGALS1", "IGF2", "TSPO"),
  # Quiescent stromal: solo 4 geni UP vs all (SSMEM1/ZBED2/MS4A6E/C6),
  # il cluster è definito principalmente da ciò che NON esprime,
  # S100A4/S100A6/TMSB10/FTH1/LGALS1 = firma stromale/FAP quiescente,
  # ADIRF = adipogenesis regulating factor, identità FAP,
  # IGF2 = segnalazione paracrino,
  # TSPO = translocator protein mitocondriale, cellule quiescenti
  # NB: pochissimi DEG significativi — usare con cautela nei plot

  cl3  = c("SERPINE1", "TAGLN", "MT1X", "MT1G", "MT1E", "ACTG2",
           "IGFBP7", "SPARC", "CXCL8", "FN1", "VIM", "CCN1", "KRT18"),
  # ECM activation (non-myogenic): SERPINE1 = PAI-1 (logFC inf vs all),
  # TAGLN = transgelin/SM22α, fenotipo miofibroblastico precoce,
  # MT1X/MT1G/MT1E = metallotioneine, risposta stress ossidativo,
  # ACTG2 = actina smooth muscle γ2, insolita in progenitori muscolari,
  # IGFBP7/SPARC = matricellulari,
  # CXCL8 = IL-8, componente pro-infiammatoria,
  # FN1/VIM/CCN1/KRT18 = fenotipo mesenchimale attivato

  cl5  = c("COL3A1", "COL1A2", "DCN", "LUM", "POSTN", "PDGFRA",
           "B2M", "IFITM3", "IFITM2", "LXN", "TMSB4X", "GABARAP"),
  # Fibroblasts-like: COL3A1/COL1A2 = collageni strutturali (logFC 613/82),
  # DCN/LUM/POSTN = proteoglicani ECM,
  # PDGFRA = marcatore fibroblasto canonico,
  # B2M/IFITM2/IFITM3 = risposta interferon (attivazione infiammatoria lieve),
  # LXN = latexin, marcatore fibroblasto stromale specifico,
  # TMSB4X = logFC inf vs all,
  # GABARAP = autofagia, cellule quiescenti/low turnover

  cl1  = c("ACTA2", "CCN2", "SERPINE1", "THBS1", "MMP11", "TIMP3","MYF5",
           "SPARC", "IGFBP3", "ELN", "APOE", "HLA-B", "TXNIP", "STAT1")
  # Myofibroblasts (fail diff): ACTA2 = αSMA, marcatore miofibroblastico canonico,
  # CCN2/CTGF + THBS1 + SERPINE1 = triade pro-fibrotica,
  # MMP11/TIMP3 = rimodellamento ECM (TIMP3 logFC 233 = il più alto del dataset!),
  # SPARC = matricellulare, attivazione fibroblastica,
  # IGFBP3 = segnalazione IGF alterata,
  # ELN = elastina, fenotipo connettivo,
  # APOE = risposta lipidica/metabolica,
  # HLA-B/STAT1 = attivazione infiammatoria/interferon,
  # TXNIP = stress ossidativo e infiammazione
)

# ── data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
meta <- as.data.frame(seurat_AB015@meta.data)

meta$monocle_clusters <- factor(
  meta$monocle_clusters,
  levels = cluster_order_ids
)

# merge cluster colours into meta for violin fill
meta <- meta %>%
  left_join(cluster_tab, by = c("monocle_clusters" = "monocle_cluster"))

# per-sample medians (for the coloured dots)
sample_medians <- meta %>%
  group_by(monocle_clusters, sample) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(names(score_labels)), median, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

# named vector for scale_fill_manual: cluster -> colour
cluster_labels_ordered <- cluster_labels[cluster_order_ids]

violin_fill_pal <- cluster_tab %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(cluster_order_ids, monocle_cluster)) %>%
  { setNames(.$cluster_color, .$monocle_cluster) }

#violin_fill_pal  <- setNames(cluster_tab$cluster_color, cluster_tab$monocle_cluster)

# ── plot loop ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for (module in names(score_labels)) {

  if (!module %in% colnames(meta)) next
  message("Plotting: ", module)

  med_long <- sample_medians %>%
    dplyr::select(monocle_clusters, sample, value = all_of(module))

  p <- ggplot(meta, aes(x = monocle_clusters, y = .data[[module]])) +

    # violin: fill = cluster colour, white interior, coloured outline
    geom_violin(
      aes(fill = monocle_clusters, color = monocle_clusters),
      alpha     = 0.25,       # light fill so dots remain visible
      trim      = FALSE,
      scale     = "width",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # coloured dots = per-sample median
    geom_point(
      data  = med_long,
      aes(x = monocle_clusters, y = value, color = sample),
      size     = 3,
      shape    = 16,
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, seed = 42)
    ) +

    # violin fill = cluster colours (light, alpha already set above)
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = violin_fill_pal,
      guide  = "none"          # don't show fill in legend
    ) +

    # colour scale shared by violin outline AND sample dots
    # we need two separate scales: one for violin outline, one for dots
    # easiest: use fill for violin, colour for dots only
    scale_color_manual(
      values = samp_pal,
      name   = "Condition",
      breaks = names(samp_pal)   # only show sample colours in legend
    ) +
scale_x_discrete(
  labels = cluster_labels_ordered,
  limits = cluster_order_ids
)
    #scale_x_discrete(labels = cluster_labels) +

    labs(
      x     = "",
      y     = "AddModuleScore",
      title = score_labels[[module]]
    ) +

    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.background    = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background   = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#eeeeee", linewidth = 0.4),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.line          = element_line(color = "#111111"),
      axis.ticks         = element_line(color = "#111111"),
      axis.text          = element_text(color = "#333333"),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1, size = 9),
      axis.title.y       = element_text(color = "#333333"),
      plot.title         = element_text(color = "#111111", face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      legend.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.text        = element_text(color = "#333333"),
      legend.title       = element_text(color = "#333333"),
      legend.key         = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fname_prefix_violin, "_violin_", module, ".pdf"),
    plot     = p,
    width    = 6,
    height   = 6
  )
}
```

```{r}
plot_violin_gene <- function(gene) {
  if (!gene %in% rownames(normalized_counts(cds))) {
    message("Gene ", gene, " not found in normalized_counts(cds); skipping.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  plot_df <- as.data.frame(colData(cds))
  plot_df$cell_id <- rownames(plot_df)

  norm_expr <- normalized_counts(cds)[gene, ]
  plot_df$expr <- as.numeric(norm_expr[plot_df$cell_id])

  # Sostituisci ID numerico con nome del cluster
  plot_df$cluster_name <- cluster_labels[as.character(plot_df$monocle_clusters)]

  # Applica l'ordine biologico come factor
  plot_df$cluster_name <- factor(
    plot_df$cluster_name,
    levels = cluster_order_names
  )

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(x = cluster_name, y = expr, fill = cluster_name)
  ) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE) +
    stat_summary(
      fun    = median,
      geom   = "crossbar",
      width  = 0.5,
      color  = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      x     = NULL,
      y     = "Normalized expression",
      title = paste0(gene, " — expression by cluster")
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
      legend.position = "none"   # colore già visibile sull'asse x
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(fname_prefix_violin, "_", gene, ".pdf"),
    plot     = p,
    width    = 8,
    height   = 5
  )
}

  plot_violin_gene(g)
}
```

###fisher exact test for AB015 clusters

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

samp_pal <- c(
  "WTpre"     = "#009E73",
  "WTmyod4"= "#0072B2",
  "LONZApre"    = "#E69F00",
  "LONZApost"  = "#D55E00",
  "OPTIOXd4"= "#CC79A7",
  "OPTIOXd7"= "#F0E442",
  "GERALTd4"= "#56B4E9",
  "GERALTd7"= "#999999"
)

pairwise_cluster_fisher <- function(meta,
                                    cluster_col = "monocle_clusters",
                                    sample_col = "sample",
                                    pairs = list(
                                      c("OPTIOXd4", "GERALTd4"),
                                      c("OPTIOXd7", "GERALTd7"),
                                      c("OPTIOXd4", "OPTIOXd7"),
                                      c("GERALTd4", "GERALTd7")
                                    )) {
  
  clusters <- sort(unique(as.character(meta[[cluster_col]])))
  
  res <- map_dfr(pairs, function(pair) {
    s1 <- pair[1]
    s2 <- pair[2]
    
    meta_sub <- meta %>%
      filter(.data[[sample_col]] %in% c(s1, s2)) %>%
      mutate(
        cluster_chr = as.character(.data[[cluster_col]]),
        sample_chr = as.character(.data[[sample_col]])
      )
    
    n1_total <- sum(meta_sub$sample_chr == s1)
    n2_total <- sum(meta_sub$sample_chr == s2)
    
    map_dfr(clusters, function(cl) {
      n1_in <- sum(meta_sub$sample_chr == s1 & meta_sub$cluster_chr == cl)
      n2_in <- sum(meta_sub$sample_chr == s2 & meta_sub$cluster_chr == cl)
      
      n1_out <- n1_total - n1_in
      n2_out <- n2_total - n2_in
      
      mat <- matrix(
        c(n1_in, n1_out,
          n2_in, n2_out),
        nrow = 2,
        byrow = FALSE,
        dimnames = list(
          c("in_cluster", "out_cluster"),
          c(s1, s2)
        )
      )
      
      ft <- fisher.test(mat)
      
      tibble(
        comparison = paste0(s1, "_vs_", s2),
        sample_1 = s1,
        sample_2 = s2,
        monocle_cluster = cl,
        count_1 = n1_in,
        total_1 = n1_total,
        frac_1 = 100 * n1_in / n1_total,
        count_2 = n2_in,
        total_2 = n2_total,
        frac_2 = 100 * n2_in / n2_total,
        diff_frac = (100 * n1_in / n1_total) - (100 * n2_in / n2_total),
        odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate),
        conf_low = ft$conf.int[1],
        conf_high = ft$conf.int[2],
        p_value = ft$p.value
      )
    }) %>%
      mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"))
  })
  
  res
}

stat_pairs <- pairwise_cluster_fisher(meta)

stat_pairs=stat_pairs%>%mutate(
  comparison = factor(stat_pairs$comparison, levels = c(
  "OPTIOXd4_vs_GERALTd4",
  "OPTIOXd7_vs_GERALTd7",
  "OPTIOXd4_vs_OPTIOXd7",
  "GERALTd4_vs_GERALTd7"
)),
significant = p_adj_BH <= 0.01,
low_count_flag = (count_1 + count_2) < 20,
prop_1 = count_1 / total_1,
prop_2 = count_2 / total_2,
log2_prop_ratio = log2((prop_1 + 1e-6) / (prop_2 + 1e-6)),
neglog10_padj = -log10(p_adj_BH + 1e-300)
)%>%
  left_join(cluster_tab, by = "monocle_cluster") %>%
  mutate(
    prop_1 = count_1 / total_1,
    prop_2 = count_2 / total_2,
    log2_prop_ratio = log2((prop_1 + 1e-6) / (prop_2 + 1e-6)),
    neglog10_padj = -log10(p_adj_BH + 1e-300),
    plot_color = ifelse(significant & !low_count_flag, cluster_color, "grey75"),
    label_me = significant & !low_count_flag
  )

write.csv(
  stat_pairs,
  file = paste0(fname_prefix_stat, "_pairwise_cluster_fisher.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

##volcano plot to show statistics of fisher exact test

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

lab_dat <- stat_pairs %>%
  filter(label_me) %>%
  group_by(comparison) %>%
  arrange(p_adj_BH, desc(abs(diff_frac))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 3) %>%
  ungroup()

p_volcano <- ggplot(
  stat_pairs,
  aes(x = diff_frac, y = neglog10_padj)
) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.01), linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey50") +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = plot_color),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    size = 3,
    stroke = 0.2,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = lab_dat,
    aes(label = cluster_name),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~comparison, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = "Difference in cluster fraction (%)",
    y = expression(-log[10](adjusted~pvalue)),
    title = "Exploratory pairwise cluster-composition differences"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(fname_prefix_stat, "_pairwise_cluster_volcano_clusterColors.pdf"),
  plot = p_volcano,
  width = 10,
  height = 7
)
```
